invariants.rationale: If LOG_COMPACT is the operation type, the method throws before exit so the only way to reach the exit is if operationType is not LOG_COMPACT.
table.getMetaClient() must be non-null as it is used unconditionally if a certain path is taken.
table.getInstantGenerator() is invoked at the start for all cases that don't throw.
table.getConfig() is required to create TransactionManager if pendingCompactionTimeline contains inflight instant.
table.getStorage() is needed for TransactionManager if rolling back compaction.
